config.detector: Si array and S3 source channels
config.model_conditions: Component positions and relative weights fixed; common Gaussian/left-tail response, scale from affine matching; omitted very weak emissions; no detector dead-layer or source self-absorption correction
config.source_reference: Pu-239, Am-241, Cm-244 identity inferred from the original nominal lines; LNHB alpha emission energies and fixed relative probabilities; source certificate and energy-loss systematics unverified

energy_convention: Source ADC calibration only; no in-beam hardware gain, run gain, attenuation or front/back terms

calibration.weights: equal anchors; covariance propagates conditional peak-center errors only
